user.title: Lumibox
user.description: Set up Lumibox? Boxes and figures are added afterwards on the integration page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

user.title: Add box
user.description: Assign a Lumibox box to a speaker and a Music Assistant user.

data_description.name: For example the child's name. Leave empty to use the device name.
data_description.esphome_device_id: The Lumibox box (ESPHome device). Each device can belong to only one box.
data_description.player_entity_id: Music Assistant player the box plays on.
data_description.ma_username: Music Assistant user of the child (for example anna). Their provider filter decides which Spotify account is used.
data_description.max_volume: Upper limit for volume changes from the box, in percent.
data_description.volume_step: Volume change per encoder detent, in percent.
data_description.default_color: LED color for figures without their own color.

user.title: Add figure
user.description: Link an NFC figure to Spotify content.

data_description.name: For example "Bobo Siebenschläfer".
data_description.uid: UID of the NFC tag, e.g. 04A1B2C3. Separators are removed. Pre-filled with the last unknown tag.
data_description.mode: What happens when the figure is placed on the box.
data_description.color: LED ring color while this figure plays. Leave empty to use the box's default color.

firmware_outdated.title: The firmware of box {box} is too old
firmware_outdated.description: Firmware of the box {box} is too old ({current}, {required} needed). Please update the firmware under Settings › Devices › {box}.

confirm.title: Update the box firmware?
confirm.description: The update is started and the box restarts when it is done. This can take a few minutes. Keep the box switched on and connected to Wi-Fi.
